items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 25 November 2026 11:20am
items.description:
##Today##

Dry but generally cloudy today, with a moderate or fresh southeast wind. Top temperature up to 8°C. Clear intervals develop this evening, with a minimum temperature overnight around 4°C. Comments: Nil.

##Comments##

##Tomorrow##

Dry for much of the day tomorrow with clear intervals at first, then cloud will gradually thicken through the day with rain arriving in the evening. Moderate or fresh southeast winds will become mainly fresh to strong by lunchtime, then possibly touch gale force around the northern and southern tips of the island in the evening. Top temperature 8°C. Comments: Strong winds. Risk of gales in exposed areas later. Snowdonia providing some shelter, limiting the extent of gale force winds.

##Friday, 27 November 2026##

Rain continues from Thursday night, turning heavy at times before clearing during Friday morning, leaving the rest of the day generally dry with sunny intervals. Strong southeast winds will ease as the rain clears, becoming a light to moderate westerly, then gradually veering to the southeast again later in the day. Top temperature 9°C. Cloud thickens again in the evening, with a few spots of rain possible. Comments: Strong winds and heavy rain. Risk of coastal overtopping (at ~00:35 hours).
